answer: Use a vertex endorsement thread: every identity is a vertex in a public trust graph, linked only by endorsements from three long-standing members, each locking a small refundable bond for thirty days when they vouch. Endorsers may vouch for only a few newcomers monthly, so a Sybil farmer must bribe many established users, and each fake costs more than the last. If a vouched account cheats, all bonds are slashed and endorsers lose standing, so honest members vet newcomers. One genuine user needs three neighbours, while mass forgery leaves a costly thread across the tundra of new accounts.
